memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow-up for newly diagnosed hypothyroidism, reports fatigue and weight gain.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/78 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.70 m, BMI 23.5 (overweight). Thyroid not enlarged, skin dry.
IMPRESSION: Overt hypothyroidism, TSH pending. Start levothyroxine 50 mcg OD.
ARRANGEMENTS: Prescribe levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, advise take on empty stomach, repeat TSH in 6 weeks. Return if worsening fatigue, palpitations, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Levothyroxine 50 mcg OD, 30 tablets, repeat after 3 months.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Persistent tiredness, mild cold intolerance.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/80, weight 68.5 kg, BMI 23.6 (overweight). No goiter.
IMPRESSION: Biochemical hypothyroidism, TSH elevated, free T4 low-normal. Need dose increase.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD, counsel adherence, repeat TSH in 6 weeks. Return if chest pain, palpitations, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, 30 tablets, repeat after 3 months.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine follow-up, feels well, energy improved.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/76, weight 68 kg, BMI 23.4 (overweight). No thyroid enlargement.
IMPRESSION: Euthyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, TSH within target.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue same dose, advise balanced diet and regular activity, repeat TSH in 6 months. Return if new palpitations, weight loss, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: General check-up, no new symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/78, weight 68.2 kg, BMI 23.5 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Stable hypothyroidism on levothyroxine 75 mcg OD, asymptomatic.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current dose, remind to take on empty stomach, repeat TSH in 6 months. Return if palpitations, excessive sweating, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Return of mild fatigue, weight gain 2 kg.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/80, weight 70.2 kg, BMI 24.3 (overweight). No thyroid enlargement.
IMPRESSION: Suboptimal thyroid control, TSH rising, free T4 low-normal. Increase levothyroxine.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levothyroxine to 100 mcg OD, counsel adherence and timing, repeat TSH in 6 weeks. Return if chest pain, palpitations, or fever >39°C.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Levothyroxine 100 mcg OD, 30 tablets, repeat after 3 months.
